about.title: About AYURM
about.content:
AYURM is a modern personal-care brand inspired by traditional Indian ingredients. We make thoughtfully formulated hair and skin care products designed for everyday use.

## What we believe

Good personal care should be simple, honest and easy to fit into daily life. We focus on well-loved botanicals — like amla, neem, bhringraj, aloe vera and saffron — and keep our range small and considered.

## How to order

You can order online with Cash on Delivery, or reach us directly on WhatsApp for help choosing products and placing an order.

*Business details such as registration and certifications will be added here as they become available.*

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.content:
## Information we collect

When you place an order, we collect the details you provide: name, mobile number, optional email, and delivery address. This is used solely to process and deliver your order.

## How we use your information

- To process, pack and deliver your orders
- To contact you about your order
- To provide customer support

## Analytics

We may use analytics tools (such as Google Analytics and Meta Pixel) to understand how visitors use our website. These may set cookies.

## Data sharing

We share order details with delivery partners only as needed to fulfil your order. We do not sell your personal information.

## Contact

For any privacy-related questions, please contact us by email.

terms-and-conditions.title: Terms & Conditions
terms-and-conditions.content:
## Use of this website

By using this website and placing an order, you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully.

## Products and pricing

We make reasonable efforts to display products and prices accurately. Prices are in Indian Rupees (INR) and may change without notice.

## Orders

Placing an order constitutes an offer to purchase. We reserve the right to accept or decline any order.

## Product information

Our products are personal-care products for external use. They are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease. Please read product precautions and patch test before use.

## Limitation of liability

To the extent permitted by law, AYURM is not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from use of the website or products.

## Contact

For any questions about these terms, please contact us by email.

shipping-policy.title: Shipping Policy
shipping-policy.content:
## Order processing

Orders are typically processed and dispatched within 2–4 business days of being placed.

## Delivery timelines

Delivery timelines vary by location and courier. Estimated delivery is usually within 4–8 business days after dispatch.

## Shipping charges

Shipping charges, if any, will be shown at checkout.

## Cash on Delivery

Cash on Delivery (COD) is available on serviceable pincodes across India.

## Order tracking

For the status of your order, please contact us on WhatsApp with your order number.

refund-policy.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
refund-policy.content:
## Order cancellation

You may request cancellation before your order is dispatched by contacting us on WhatsApp or email.

## Returns

If you receive a damaged or incorrect product, please contact us within 48 hours of delivery with photos so we can help resolve it.

## Refunds

Where applicable, refunds will be processed to the original payment method or by another agreed method within a reasonable time.

## How to request

To request a cancellation, return or refund, contact us on WhatsApp with your order number.
